## Import the Data 
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
figure6 <- read_excel("Figure 6 Source data.xlsx", sheet = "Figure 6f")
colnames(figure6) <- c("Trials", "Vehicle", "CTPI2")
figure6 <- figure6[-1, ]
```

## Examine the Data
```{r}
dim(figure6)
str(figure6)
head(figure6)
is.na(figure6)
```

## Reproduce Figure 6f 
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
figure6$Trials <- factor(figure6$Trials, levels = c("Trial 1", "Trial 2", "Trial 3", "Trial 4", "Trial 5","Trial 6", "Trial 7", "Trial 8", "Trial 9", "Trial 10"))

str(figure6)
figure6$Vehicle <- as.numeric(figure6$Vehicle)
figure6$CTPI2 <- as.numeric(figure6$CTPI2)

fig6f<- ggplot(data = figure6, mapping = aes(x= Trials, group = 1))+
  geom_point(aes(y = Vehicle, color = "vehicle", size = "size"))+
  geom_line(aes(y = Vehicle, linewidth = "lw", color = "vehicle")) +
  geom_point(aes(y = CTPI2, size = "size", color = "CTPI2"))+
  geom_line(aes(y = CTPI2, linewidth = "lw", color = "CTPI2"))+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,100), breaks = seq(0,100, by = 20), expand = c(0.004,0))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("vehicle"="black", "CTPI2" = "green"))+
  scale_linewidth_manual(values = c("lw"=0.5))+
  scale_size_manual(values = c("size"= 3))+
  labs(title = "f", x= "Trials", y = "Percentage of mice hanging 90 s (hanging test)")+
  guides(size = FALSE, linewidth = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45)) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(color = "black"), axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"))+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold")) +
  theme(legend.position = "inside",
        legend.position.inside = c(0.15,0.85)) 

print(fig6f)
ggsave("figure6f/fig6f.pdf")

```
